about: Owner rule 11-03: never run on the OFFICIAL Godot. Only the engines listed under 'engines' (our patched fork Thom-Ernst/godot eawr/4.7.2-stable) may run measurements, gates, rig suites, previews and packages. tools/common/engine_guard.py and tools/common/EngineGuard.ps1 enforce it; EAWR_ALLOW_UNPATCHED_ENGINE=ab-control (exact) is the only bypass: a labelled control arm of an engine A/B. The viewer checks the same commits at startup (include/eawr/presentation/engine_signature.hpp).

eawr-5b733a90f-ltofull.build: MSVC 19.44 target=editor production=yes lto=full (2026-11-10, re-spirv off: RESPV_ENABLED 0)
eawr-5b733a90f-ltofull.role: player: the exe shipped in the player zip (fork release eawr-4.7.2-5b733a90f); rig/preview/perf default since the B1 pin

eawr-fad06b579-ltofull.role: previous player engine (before the B1 pin, 2026-11-10; the rollback target): same exe as fork release eawr-4.7.2-fad06b579; accepted for A/B comparisons, no longer the default

eawr-fad06b579-nolto.build: MSVC target=editor production=yes, no LTO (first fork build, up to +5.7% slower in Safe)
eawr-fad06b579-nolto.role: diagnostic only: same patches, not the shipped binary; never mix with ltofull numbers in one series

eawr-fad06b579-template-release.role: export template: measurement only, not shipped (pf-export-build). The exe that RUNS is the exported game (template + embedded PCK, a new sha per export): pin it per export or run it as EAWR_ALLOW_UNPATCHED_ENGINE=ab-control

eawr-fad06b579-template-release-pathover.role: measurement only, path overrides ON, NOT SHIPPABLE (pf-export-build): the same template with --path/--script allowed so the rig harness can run an exported package (4.7 templates refuse them by default). The exported exe gets a new sha per export: pin it per export

official-4.7.2-template-release.about: the official 4.7.2 template_release export template (pf-export-build reference); REFUSED
